name: R packages (via pak)
description: Installs R packages via the pak package. R must be already installed.

packages.description: Comma separated list of packages to install, passed to the `pak::pak()` function.

pakVersion.description: Version of pak to install. By default, the stable version is installed if needed.

installSystemRequirements.description: Install the system requirements of the packages at build time, using the commands generated by `pak::pkg_sysreqs()` (run by root) on the platforms supported by pak (e.g. Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL-based, openSUSE).

cranMirror.description: The CRAN mirror to use for installing packages. Converted to the `PKG_CRAN_MIRROR` env var if not empty.

notCran.description: The 'NOT_CRAN' environment variable that is referenced during the installation of this Feature.
